author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! For the last year I've made a point to educate the masses about the draconian authoritarian sweep occuring on our Internet. We now have numerous different bills all being pushed through at the same time and sadly it seems many people are now okay with this level of surveillance. All we can do now is individually fight back as much as we can and I'll teach you how. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: We Lost...
